raw_context:
Spire Health does not operate as a traditional multi-brand distributor or retail seller of third-party consumer or medical manufacturing brands. Instead, they are a proprietary digital healthcare technology developer that
manufactures and distributes their own continuous respiratory and health tracking hardware
Medical Device Network
Proprietary Hardware:
Their core product is the proprietary
Spire Health Tag
(and its predecessor
Spire Stone
), which was designed, engineered, and sold directly or through select consumer channels like
Apple Stores
TechCrunch
B2B & Clinical Transition:
The company shifted from direct consumer sales to a B2B and remote patient monitoring (RPM) model focused on chronic respiratory care.
PR Newswire
Acquisition Context:
Wellinks
acquired Spire Health to integrate Spire's proprietary respiratory monitoring technology into their virtual cardiopulmonary care services.
Gilde Healthcare
Component Manufacturers:
While they do not sell other brands, they utilize specific component manufacturers for their hardware (such as utilizing ultra-thin supercapacitors from
CAP-XX
CAP-XX

Spire Health—acquired by virtual-first cardiopulmonary care leader
Wellinks
—develops continuous respiratory and ambulatory monitoring products. Its core brand and manufacturing/investor ecosystem include the
Spire Health Tag
and
Spire RPM system
developed alongside strategic technological and financial partners
www.hospitalmanagement.net
Product Brands
Spire Health Tag:
A clinical-grade, machine-washable wearable sensor that discreetly adheres to clothing or undergarments to continuously monitor respiration, heart rate, sleep, and activity.
Business Insider
Spire RPM System:
An FDA-cleared remote patient monitoring platform utilizing proprietary algorithms to track vital signs and predict cardiopulmonary deterioration (especially for COPD and asthma).
Yahoo Finance
Spire Stone:
The early-generation predecessor device focused on breath and stress tracking.
WWD
Manufacturer & Strategic Partners
Wellinks:
Acquired Spire Health to integrate its continuous monitoring hardware into a unified virtual cardiopulmonary care model.
Tooploox:
Long-term software development partner that collaborated on Spire's mobile and web application architecture.
Gilde Healthcare:
Lead investor and backer that funded Spire's transition and subsequent integration phases.
University of Massachusetts Memorial Health (UMMH):
Key financial and clinical collaborator supporting commercial scaling.
